model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart presents a comparison of the accuracy percentages of different teaching strategies across three categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The teaching strategies include DAPO+Self-reflection, DAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and PPO. The vertical axis represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, while the horizontal axis lists the three categories. Each teaching strategy is represented by a unique color, allowing for an easy comparison of their performance in each category. The chart shows varying levels of accuracy among the teaching strategies, with some outperforming others in specific categories. The accuracy values are not explicitly provided for each bar, but the relative differences can be observed visually. The bars are not ordered in any specific sequence, and there is no additional information provided to suggest patterns in the data, such as trends in accuracy with increasing or decreasing categories.
model_annotations.Chinese:
The bar chart presents the accuracy percentages of different methodological approaches or techniques (represented by various colors) across three different subject categories: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis signifies the accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with consistent increments of 2%. Each subject category has four bars corresponding to the four techniques, with labels at the base indicating the name of the technique.

In the Mathverse category, the blue bars represent "DAPO+Self-reflection" with an accuracy between 56% and 58%, and the blue striped bars denote "PPO" with an accuracy just below 56%. For "Mathverse," the orange bars for "SRPO" and the green striped bars for "PPO+Self-reflection" show that "SRPO" has the lowest accuracy, while "PPO+Self-reflection" indicates the highest accuracy, just under 58%. In MMLU, the techniques displayed are "DAPO" with striped pattern, "GRPO" with orange solid fill, "MMLU" with blue striped pattern, and "SRPO" with green solid fill. The accuracy percentage for "MMLU" ranges between about 54% and 56%. In the Physics category, the techniques include "GRPO," "PPO+Self-reflection," and "SRPO" from left to right. The blue bars for "PPO+Self-reflection" depict that it has the highest accuracy, slightly above 58%, while the green stripes again represent "SRPO," which has the lowest accuracy, just below 54%.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the comparison of accuracy percentages for different Natural Language Processing (NLP) models across three subject-focused datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis, representing accuracy, is labeled with values ranging from 50% to 62%, indicating the proportion of test questions correctly answered. The horizontal axis lists the three datasets. There is one value per bar group, representing a different combination of an NLP model and a type of knowledge graph (KG) used in combination with self-reflection or not. The models compared include DAPO with and without self-reflection, SRPO, GRPO, and PPO with self-reflection. The DAPO model paired with self-reflection generally shows the highest accuracy in each dataset, followed closely by the PPO model with self-reflection. Brush or dotted pattern overlays on some bars suggest a particular emphasis within emotional and epistemic reasoning, but without labels, the exact nature of this emphasis is unclear. The bars vary in height according to the varying accuracy levels, with the exact percentages provided in the range of approximately 52% to 62%.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit verschiedener Algorithmen bei der Vervollständigung verschiedener Aufgaben: Mathverse, MMMU und Physics, basierend auf ihren Zuständen beim Rahmen und Ego-Reflektion. Die x-Achse repräsentiert die drei Aufgaben, während die y-Achse einen Prozentsatz zwischen 50% und 62% darstellt. Die Algorithmen DAPO+Self-reflection, SAPO, SRPO, GRPO, PPO, PPO+Self-reflection und PPPO werden mit unterschiedlichen Farben dargestellt. Um eine genaue Abstimmung der Werte zu gewährleisten, wurden längere Stiche bei den Balken für ein paar Prozentbereiche hinzugefügt, während der Rest auf Runden der nächstgelegenen Vollzahl fiel. GRPO zeigte die höchste Genauigkeit in jeder Aufgabe, während SRPO die niedrigsten Genauigkeiten für Mathverse und MMU aufweist. In allen Räumen zeigt sich eine Anhöhe von SAPO über SRPO, während MAPO über SRPO liegt. GRPO erscheint konsistent mit den höchsten Prozentwerten. Die Graphik zeigt keine Anmerkungen oder Hervorhebungen, die signifikante Aspekte hervorheben, sodass es sich nicht auf visuelle Elemente für Implikationen beruht.
